column2: I respected the prestige allocation designed by PG2 authors: this means that most of the time no prestige points are granted between scenario, this shows the logictics constraints of the Wehrmacht to carry out Operation Sealion. Since the way to handle prestige is different in PG2 and in PeG I added some trigger hexes to allow the player to gather only a few prestige points he must spend before the end of a scenario. This will allow him to purchase max one new unit to replace a killed unit.
